facts.business: Muthoot Finance Limited is India's largest gold loan NBFC, providing loans against gold jewellery through a pan-India branch network and operating subsidiaries in microfinance, housing finance, vehicle finance, and Sri Lankan financial services.

segments.name: Gold Loan Extensions (Muthoot Money, Asia Asset Finance, Belstar Microfinance)
Adjacent Financial Services (Muthoot Homefin, Vehicle Loans)

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matters: Allowance for expected credit losses (ECL) on loans and advances; Information technology and general controls

key_risks: Credit risk from adverse selection of borrowers/groups
Operational risk from high-volume IT systems across multiple platforms
Model risk in ECL estimation with macroeconomic overlays
Gold price volatility impacting collateral coverage
Regulatory and compliance risks in gold loan and microfinance operations
